newsitem.title: GREECE: Agricultural Bank/Greece gets ecu 250 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Agricultural Bank/Greece gets ecu 250 mln loan.

text.p: State Agricultural Bank of Greece signed a syndicated loan of ecu 250 million at Libor plus 0.125 percent with a consortium of foreign banks led by Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi and Credit Suisse First Boston, it said.
"The interest rate of the loan was set at Libor plus 0.125 percent annually, the best that a Greek bank has succeeded in getting in international markets," it said in a statement.
The loan proceeds will be used for prompt payment of EU subsidies to farmers.
The terms of the loan make it possible for the Agricultural Bank to borrow an additional ecu 250 million via a tender panel facility, it said.
The loan was oversubscribed in a short period of time, it added. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
